questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Personal connection to the destination (heritage / friends there/ etc.)

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ønskede at komme på udveksling til et engelsktalende land. University of Birmingham (UoB) er en stor campus, hvor det er muligt at bo på campus, hvilket jeg ønskede.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer:
UoB holdte flere zooms møder, hvor de gav god information, det var også nemt at komme i kontakt med nogen og få svar på spørgsmål. 

Det var dog lidt svært at finde noget information på egen hånd.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Man blev tildelt en ”personal tutor”, som man kunne kontakte og holde møder med. Universitet sendte også mange mails med information og var nemme at komme i kontakt med.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Som udvekslingsstuderende er der to muligheder for at på bo campus. 1) Tennis Court (hvor jeg boede) her delte man både toilet/bad og køkken med 4 andre og 2) Mason, hvor man havde eget toilet/bad, men man delte køkken med 5-6 andre.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Man havde et stort godt køkken, hvor det var muligt at lave mad.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
questions.answer:
Selv om det ikke er det mest luksuøse var det virkelig en god oplevelse, hvor man møder de fleste af ens venner. Jeg var personligt meget glad for Tennis Court og kan varmt anbefale det. 

Tennis Court er kendt som det mere sociale sted at bo ift. Mason.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Processen var fin og meget lige til, men man fik sit ”letter of acceptance” forholdsvis sent.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: UoB holdte flere zooms møder, hvor de forklarede processen og var nemme at komme i kontakt med, hvis man havde spørgsmål.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer:
Jeg var meget successful. Jeg fik alle de fag jeg ønskede (det er dog lidt sjovt at man skal ansøge om 12 fag selv om man kun skal have 3). 
Der var heller ikke noget problem da jeg skiftede et fag to uger før start.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Deltag i de møde UoB holder og hold dig opdateret. Jeg stressede meget over at jeg fik mit ”letter of acceptance” ret sent, men det er normalt og det skal nok ordne sig.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Efter min erfaring var pensum og eksamensformerne generelt nemmere end på KU. At det var på engelsk, gjorde dog at jeg stadig brugte en del tid på at læse pensum og forberede mig til undervisning.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Selve undervisningsformen var meget den samme som på KU. Der var dog generelt færre undervisningstimer og der var flere forelæsninger ift. seminarer.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
LH Intellectual Property Law (10 ECTS)
LH Employment Law in Practice (10 ECTS)
LC Law, Justice and Ethics (10 ECTS)

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Employment Law in Practice: Var virkelig et fedt fag med spænende pensum og gode undervisere. 
Intellectual Property Law: Selve pensum var meget spænende, men faglederen (som også holder forelæsningerne) var desværre en dårlig formidler og gjorde at jeg ikke brød mig særlig meget om faget. Jeg var heller ikke fan af eksamensformen ift. andre fag. 
Law, Justice and Ethics: Dette er et første års fag, hvilket jeg var meget glad for at have, da de andre to fag fyldte meget. Det er et hyggeligt fag med en rolig eksamensform.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Jeg brugte flere penge på transport og oplevelser end forventet, da man rejser meget rundt i England.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Indkøbsvare var cirka 10-15 % billigere end i Danmark, men ellers koster alt stort set det samme.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
Alt – På UoB har de stort set alle former for sport og alle former for klubber/societies, der er virkelig noget for enhver smag. 
Da UoB er én stor campus er alt samlet på et sted, hvilket virkelig giver en fed universitetsoplevelse.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer:
Jeg var selv medlem af Volleyball holdet, hvilket jeg var meget glad for. Jeg anbefaler helt klart at man deltager på et sportshold (så man kan deltage til Sports Night:))
Jeg havde også et medlemskab til deres fitness, hvor de tilbød et stort træningscenter + svømmehal + holdtræning + mulighed for at booke squash- og tennisbaner. 

Derudover var flere af mine venner medlem af fx: Tennis, fodbold, basketball, art society, hiking society, theater society og meget andet.

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer:
Jeg anbefaler klart at man tager til London, men også at man tager til flere af de andre byer, som ligger rundt om Birmingham. Jeg var selv i: Nottingham, Oxford, Bristol, Liverpool og Edinburgh. 

I hverdagene anbefaler jeg at man udforsker og oplever Birmingham (den har mere at byde på end forventet;))

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var meget nemt.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Bliv medlem af et sportshold eller en klub. Bo på campus og vær åben.

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Der var ikke den store kulturforskel.

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Den studiekultur der var på UoB var virkelig fed at opleve, da det var en stor campus.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1) Bo på campus, 2) bliv medlem af en sportsklub eller society og 3) vær åben, forvent ikke at find dine bedste venner, men nogle nice mennesker som du kan få nogle fede oplevelser med.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: UoB kan godt være lidt langsom med at give information, men hvis du har nogle vigtige spørgsmål, er de hurtige til at svare og vil gerne hjælpe.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer:
For mig var det klart at blive bedre til engelsk og møde en masse søde mennesker, som man fik nogle fede oplevelser med. 

At bo på en samlet campus var virkelig en fed oplevelse og noget jeg vil anbefale alle at prøve, da det er så langt fra et studieliv på KU.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Det krævede lidt ekstra arbejde, at alt undervisning var på engelsk.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer:
Jeg var virkelig glad for mit udviklingsforhold på UoB og kan varmt anbefale det til alle. Hvis du har nogle spørgsmål, ift. et udvekslingsophold på UoB, er du velkommen til at kontakte mig; cml553@
alumni.ku.dk

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
